info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Statements API
info.description: The Financial Statements API provides access to comprehensive financial reports and statements related to banking transactions. Users can retrieve detailed financial data for specific accounts by providing the relevant account identifier. This API is essential for financial analysts and auditors who require accurate and timely financial information for reporting or compliance purposes. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their financial analytics capabilities and streamline their reporting processes.

get.summary: Retrieve financial statement details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the financial statement associated with the specified ID. Use this to access detailed financial data for analysis or reporting.
